comments.name: Global Citizen
comments.content: Oh wow, iPhone 18 Pro sounds really interesting, especially the imaging experience. Austin Mann's reviews are always on point. I wonder how it compares to the latest Android flagships in terms of computational photography. Plus, that ADHD-designed app? That's actually pretty innovative, a lot of friends abroad could use something like that for executive function support. It's great to see more focus on neurodiversity in tech. 🧠💻

comments.name: 股海沉浮
